Meta.title: Ashraf Salah | Frontend Developer (React & Next.js)
Meta.description: Portfolio of Ashraf Salah, a Frontend Developer from Egypt who builds fast, responsive web apps with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

Landing.quoteReason: If an interface doesn't earn your attention in the first few seconds, nobody stays to discover what's behind it.
Landing.developerDescription: I build fast, responsive, and easy-to-use web interfaces with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I write clean, maintainable code, work with REST APIs, manage state with Redux and Context API, and connect products to backends like Firebase and Supabase. My goal is to ship polished, high-performance work that is genuinely useful to the people who use it.

About.title: About Me
About.p1: I'm a frontend developer based in Tanta, Egypt, with over a year of hands-on experience. I turn ideas and designs into fast, responsive web products using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, with a strong focus on clean code and user experience.
About.p2: My interest in cybersecurity, from CTF challenges to building a cybersecurity academy's website, shapes how I work: I think about how systems can fail and keep security in mind from the start.
About.p3: I'm currently open to new opportunities and freelance projects, and I'd love to join a cross-functional team that believes inclusive design can make people's lives better.

tech.q: Which technologies do you work with?
tech.a: Mainly React.js and Next.js with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, plus Redux and React Query for state and data, and Firebase on the backend side.

figma.q: Can you turn a Figma or Adobe XD design into code?
figma.a: Yes. I convert Figma and Adobe XD designs into responsive web applications that match the original design.

freelance.a: Yes. I've been working on freelance projects since 2024 and I'm open to new ones, as well as full-time frontend roles.

time.q: How long does a project take?
time.a: It depends on the scope and the number of pages and features. Once we talk through the requirements, I'll give you a realistic estimate before starting.

admin.q: Can you build dashboards and connect to APIs?
admin.a: Yes. I've built admin panels for managing products, orders, and users, and a competition management dashboard, all connected to REST APIs.

language.q: Which languages can we communicate in?
language.a: Arabic (native) and English (good command, written and spoken).
